review_type: coordinator source-based review; unblinded and uncalibrated
scale: 1 material failure; 2 major correction; 3 usable with gaps; 4 strong for supplied scope

cases.rationale: Both preserve unknown finances, foreign existence/closure limits and censored VC counts. Candidate explicitly enumerates transfer conditions and founder constraints; both propose concrete unpaid discovery tests.

Both correctly calculate CHF1000 revenue, CHF800 contribution, CHF700 burn and 14.3-month runway. Candidate adds the zero-customer downside (6.7 months), monthly exhaustion context and contribution sensitivity. Both leave local payment and founder capacity unresolved.

Both distinguish title-only metadata, signups, failed expansion, undisclosed funding and unknown investor identity. Candidate explicitly separates topic-led and entity-led customer research, maps foreign transfer conditions and avoids mandatory canvases.

limitations: Three synthetic tasks, one run per arm; no statistical inference.
The same coordinator saw the candidate before reviewing the pairs; not an independent blind review.
Generation used isolated read-only Codex workspaces; exact model version and billing were not emitted by the runtime.
No human calibration or new customer research. All outputs remain provisional planning examples.
Numeric/statistical ratings are coordinator judgments, not measured downstream business performance.
